text: APPROVE. Moving the per-option scoring into `Evaluate` leaves `Read` well under 15 and `Evaluate` at about 7. Behaviour is identical because the original loop body always returned on its first non-skipped iteration, exactly as `return Evaluate(text, name)` does now. Nothing in the diff should trigger a build warning. I only had the diff, so I couldn't check whether another `Evaluate` already exists in the class, and I didn't run a build.
